column1: # Stage S11a, agent J3a — the Enfusion archive reader and the script oracle leave developer_tools.
# developer_tools' pak reader becomes the enfusion_pak crate; its script oracle (the `enf`
# library) and xtask's vanilla page mirrors behind `cargo xtask fetch` become the
# enfusion_script_index crate, while the `fetch` command line stays in xtask and calls it. The
# crate roots, the empty-write guard's module and the read-policy module are written by hand.
# Paths name the tree before the moves.
# enfusion_pak: the module root becomes the crate root; the module README lands as the source README
# enfusion_script_index: the oracle module, its command line and its tests
# enfusion_script_index: the vanilla page mirrors behind `cargo xtask fetch`
# the feature document follows the crate into the enfusion mirror
# the moved code names its own crate
